annotations.title: Events on a day, with company

description: Use for any question about what is happening in a city on a date (city slug, date YYYY-MM-DD) and whether other travellers are going: each listed event with its ticket link (url), the TripHook What's on page for that day (whats_on), how many open public day outs are going and their links (company). The reply ends with links: show them as one short line, for example "Search on TripHook · What's on". Public fields only, never a person.
name: events_and_company
